== Biography ==

== Trivia ==
* Reached 1000 kills in the LPL on February 12, 2023.
** The 37th player and 4th toplaner (after [[Flandre]], [[TheShy]] and [[369]]) to reach 1000 kills in the LPL.
* Reached 1500 kills in the LPL on April 12, 2025.
** The 27th player and 4th toplaner to reach 1500 kills in the LPL.
* Reached 500 games in the LPL on January 15, 2025
** The 26th player to reach 500 games in the LPL.
* Reached 600 games in the LPL on August 15, 2025
** The 19th player to reach 600 games in the LPL.
* Reached 300 wins in the LPL on September 01, 2025.
** Was the 27th player to reach 300 wins in the LPL.
* Reached 3000 assists in the LPL on September 13, 2025.
** Was the 44th player to reach 3000 assists in the LPL.
